match.result: Quarax wins 2–1 after DragonJG concedes the match

games.summary: Quarax turns a large damage total into a lethal Shuang Ji attack.

beats.text: Arisanna builds herbs and Polaris while Quarax struggles to find smooth level progression.
Prima Materia and Cosmic Bolt pressure Jin, but Quarax reaches level 3 and keeps recovering.
Quarax uses Auric Persecution to remove Consumption Ring and keep his recovery available.
After Devil’s Lifeline draws out Astral Seal, Enrage and Shuang Ji of Sacrifice produce the 25-damage attack that ends the game.

games.summary: DragonJG breaks through Quarax’s recovery with Cosmic Bolts and four Astral Seals.

beats.text: Quarax reaches level 3 first and chips in with his Guides while Arisanna waits for Dungeon Guide.
Meteor Strike removes Berserker Plate, then destroys Shuang Ji of Sacrifice after Quicksilver Grail brings it out.
Tricastles of Lucenia constrains both players; Auric Persecution removes Cosmic Astroscope and slows Arisanna’s glimpses.
Nascent Barrier finds Cosmic Bolt. Astral Seals stop recovery, a second glimpse finds more Bolts, and the fourth Seal answers Topsy Decree for the concession.

games.summary: Scalding Aethercharge accelerates Suzaku, and Intensified Pyre finishes the game.

beats.text: SoSollys starts establishing a Clubs board with Shamrock Forest.
Vermilion Decree pressures an ally and the champion; Scalding Aethercharge then punishes Silvie’s level-up and adds quest counters.
Nullifying Mirror precedes the finishing push. Skirting Step prevents a point, but a kindled Intensified Pyre supplies the remaining damage.

games.summary: NoobTinnn uses Undeniable Truth to bring Suzaku back for another lethal attack.

beats.text: SoSollys develops Six of Clubs and Censer of Restful Peace while NoobTinnn continues building quest counters.
Two of Spades and Safeguard Amulet create pressure and protection, but SoSollys stays at spirit level.
Suzaku attacks, then Undeniable Truth enables its sacrifice and return. After a brief judge check about quest counters, casters confirm NoobTinnn’s second win.
